summary: The agent replaced the purely synthetic CRM backdrop with real external procurement data: it now imports roughly 190 live USASpending.gov award records from `https://api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award/` or falls back to `data/usaspending_naics541512_fy2023.csv` with 200 real records, and it swapped the three named target deals from Hyperion/Zenith/Apex to Weis Markets/VSE Corporation/Insteel Industries.
bullets: Background data changed from hand-seeded leads to USASpending.gov NAICS 541512 FY2023 contract awards, $50K-$500K, described as real messy data.
Primary source is `https://api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award/`; fallback is bundled `data/usaspending_naics541512_fy2023.csv` with 200 records.
Import mechanism changed to Odoo `crm.lead.load()` XML-RPC bulk import; if that fails, the script falls back to per-record `create()`.
The three task-specific records were renamed to real companies: Weis Markets, VSE Corporation, and Insteel Industries, with real-company metadata cited.
Verifier, export script, checklist, task metadata, and validated PI were all updated to expect Weis/VSE/Insteel instead of Hyperion/Zenith/Apex.
Missed part: the three target opportunities are still manually created in `setup_task.sh`, so task-critical records remain hand-seeded rather than externally imported.
addressed_reason: The agent did add a real external-data import pipeline and bundled a real CSV snapshot, which directly addresses the complaint about lacking messy external data. But the three actual opportunities the user must review are still scripted into Odoo manually, so the task is not fully converted away from hand-seeded CRM records.
